failure_summary.description: Agents repeated base searches instead of retrieving compatible cached results and filtering only the changed criteria.
Agents represented a return date as an arrival date or failed to update each directional flight leg separately.
The agent shortened the user's neighborhood text instead of preserving the full name.

patch.reasoning: These patterns are already explicitly covered by the skill's cache-selection, per-leg flight, and exact-entity-text rules. A new edit would duplicate existing guidance; a prior proposed elaboration of the cache rule was also rejected.
